# Steady Orbit Systems

> AI automation for small and mid-sized businesses. We design the system, build it, launch it, and hand over the controls. Then it runs itself.

Steady Orbit Systems builds websites, workflow automation, and custom AI agents for small and mid-sized businesses. Every engagement is designed around how the business already works, shipped end to end, and handed over with the owner in control.

## Services

- [Websites](https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/): fast, human-written marketing sites with real content, structured data, and no dark patterns.
- [Workflows & Automation](https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/): lead capture, follow-up, and back-office workflows that run themselves.
- [AI Agents](https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/): custom AI assistants and voice agents trained on the business's own services and rules.
- [Systems Lab](https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/systems-lab/): live, interactive demos — AI receptionists for a barber shop, auto shop, and car wash.
- [Revenue Blind Spot diagnostic](https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/revenue-blind-spot/): a free diagnostic that finds the gaps costing a business revenue.
